title: Bronze source artifact
description: One raw file (scan, PDF, image, transcription) registered in the bronze layer. The text_id is supplied by the person registering the file, never inferred from the filename.

artifact_id.description: Derived from the first 12 hex characters of sha256. Stable for identical bytes.

text_id.description: Text in manifest/source_register.json that this file is a copy of.

original_filename.description: Name as received. Recorded for reference only; never parsed for meaning.

media_type.description: Detected from the file's leading bytes, not from its extension.

page_count.description: Filled in when the file is processed. Absent until then.

processing_status.description: 'registered' means the bytes are fingerprinted but no text has been extracted yet.

extraction_method.description: Shared with rule.schema.json. 'registered_by_reference' means only the file was fingerprinted.
